about: XLOOKUP: match and search modes, wildcards, regular expressions, binary search and its refusals (ADR-0047, ADR-0049). match_mode 3 accepts only the constructs whose meaning is the same in PCRE2 and .NET, and refuses any other pattern with #VALUE!.
